title: primula viscosa subsp. graveolens
intro: Primula viscosa subsp. graveolens, commonly known as Sticky Primrose, is a plant species within the Primulaceae family, characterized by its sticky leaves and fragrant flowers. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential remedy for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antiseptic properties. Additionally, the plant's leaves and flowers are used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties.
